reading.zh: InputManager 是入口；键图标表只为 InputManager 的显示服务；快捷键与轮盘驱动从两者读取局内意图。3C 重构前这整个子树挂在 framework 下，重构把代码物理迁到 Assets/Scripts/Runtime/3C/Control 后，模块树也跟着搬过来。
reading.en: InputManager is the entry point, the key-icon map only renders what InputManager displays, and the shortcut/wheel drivers read gameplay intent from both. All of it lived under framework before the 3C refactor moved the code to Assets/Scripts/Runtime/3C/Control.
